name: Kikkoman Sweet Teriyaki Glaze & Marinade (Strained)
whyItWorks: A smooth reduction of brewed soy sauce, sugar, wine, and vinegar with all seeds and coarse ginger/garlic chunks strained out. Delivers sweet savory glaze flavor that adheres to lean chicken breast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush a light tablespoon over chicken or salmon during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
watchOuts: Contains sugar and mild wine vinegar; avoid drowning food in sauce.
